Insight, not decisions. Every answer arrives with the query or citation behind it so you can verify it yourself. This copilot will not recommend or imply an approval, denial or pend — that determination is yours. Where evidence is missing it is reported as INDETERMINATE, never as a pass or a fail.

Reads only the governed M360MART.SERVING layer — no access to raw bronze, silver or gold tables. No SSN, address, email or phone is exposed. Criteria are reported as MET / UNMET / INDETERMINATE and are never collapsed into an overall verdict.
